home.title: Wholesale buying opportunities
home.description: Browse the opportunities on offer and see the product, the shipping origin city and the closing date. Commercial terms appear once you sign in with a trader account.
home.policiesDescription: Read the published policies before creating an account.

bankAccount.title: Payment and refunds
bankAccount.description: How your orders are paid for, and where a refund goes.
bankAccount.paymentPoint: Payment is taken at checkout by the payment provider. Your card details never pass through FORSA.
bankAccount.refundPoint: A refund is returned to the same payment method it was taken from, not to a bank account.
bankAccount.noStoredDetailsPoint: FORSA holds no bank account for traders. Bank accounts are required from suppliers only, so they can be paid out.

taxProfile.title: Tax profile
taxProfile.description: Your billing legal name and VAT registration status.

taxProfile.selfDeclaredNotice: These details are declared by the company itself and are not verified by a third party.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: Opportunities available to buy, with pricing and commercial terms.
opportunities.emptyDescription: There are no opportunities available right now.
opportunities.emptyFilteredDescription: No opportunities match the current filters. Try widening them.

detail.unsoldCaveat: The unsold quantity is arithmetic, not a reservation. The quantity is confirmed when you start a purchase.
detail.progressCaveat: This is the share of the available quantity that has sold. Reaching it unlocks nothing — every paid order is fulfilled on its own.

checkout.title: Review your order
checkout.description: Check the details and the amount before paying.

locked.notReserved: The quantity is not guaranteed until payment completes successfully.

pending.title: Payment in progress
pending.description: A payment has been started for this order and has not completed yet.

paid.title: Paid
paid.description: Payment completed and the order was created.

expired.title: The hold expired
expired.description: The quantity hold for this order expired and it can no longer be completed. Start again from the opportunity.

abandoned.title: Order cancelled
abandoned.description: This order was cancelled and the quantity released. Start again from the opportunity.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed.

pending.description: The payment is confirmed by the payment provider directly. You will be taken to the order as soon as the confirmation arrives.

pending.doNotClose: You can leave this page open. Closing it does not affect the payment itself.
pending.contractError: The order status could not be confirmed because the response was inconsistent. Contact support before trying again.

EXPIRED.title: The hold expired
EXPIRED.description: The quantity hold expired before the payment completed. If any amount was taken it is returned to the same payment method.

ABANDONED.title: Order cancelled
ABANDONED.description: This order was cancelled. If any amount was taken it is returned to the same payment method.

compose.title: Choose a quantity and continue
compose.availabilityCaveat: That is arithmetic, not a reservation. The quantity is confirmed by the server when the purchase starts.
compose.totalsComeLater: Shipping, VAT and the total amount are calculated by the server and shown on the review page before payment.

noLocations.title: No branches registered
noLocations.description: A purchase cannot start until at least one branch is registered to receive the order.
